summary: Micware Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K to furnish the English translation of its Notice of Annual General Meeting of Shareholders by Written Resolution. The meeting is to approve financial statements for the 23rd fiscal year (March 1, 2025 to February 28, 2026) and elect one director, Kazunori Mori. The written resolution process follows the Japanese Companies Act, with a consent deadline of May 29, 2026. This filing is a routine AGM notice with no special-situations deal terms or strategic changes. No price, premium, or advisory details are present. There is no event-driven catalyst beyond standard corporate governance.
